environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Negative: hop 1's own 4-token refusal is what forces the double-encoded form. Named so a later agent does not read it as a chain failure.
findings.title: A 4-token upstream line is refused by hop 1, which is why the chain needs double encoding

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
methods: Control request first on the same config
Raw client bytes and raw upstream bytes captured in hex
Payload diffed against the control line

author_attested: analysis metadata reconstructed after the run

source SHA-256 and report and evidence hashes

scope: Delivery amplification: two-hop proxy chains, cache-key control with a smuggled body, and TLS parity. Execution is on whichever host the chain terminates at.
